title: Planning Kits: Spreadsheets and Organizers for Legal Costs
description: Downloadable planning kits from LegalCostGuides: compare lawyer quotes, budget a divorce, organize family information and prepare a small claims case.
body: Our planning kits are spreadsheets and printable organizers that help you compare, budget and prepare. They are not legal advice and they are not legal documents. Every kit has a 14-day refund (policy and license).
